entities.name: Abu al-Qasim al-Zahrawi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū al-Qāsim Khalaf ibn al-'Abbās al-Zahrāwī al-Ansari, popularly known as al-Zahrawi, Latinised as Albucasis or Abulcasis, was an Arab physician, surgeon and chemist from al-Andalus. He is considered one of the greatest surgeons of the Middle Ages.
